issues.desc: background.md Key Insights claims doctor.ts:760/:773 (git ls-files / git check-ignore) "run with cwd=root (metadataRoot)" but those calls use cwd:repoRoot (a variable). The actual cwd=root problem for that section is the git rev-parse --show-toplevel at :800 that discovers repoRoot. The four affected sites listed (:505/:554/:760/:773) are correct in net effect but the :760/:773 mechanism is indirect (they fail because :800 fails first). Low precision issue; the fix approach in CHK-001 is correct and unambiguous.
